$comment: The five-element ring, GAME_DESIGN.md section 5. Damage.ts contains no literals. Each type beats exactly one and loses to exactly one, which is legible enough to teach without a chart and still makes Hall counters matter.
$comment_ring: Verdant -> Tide -> Ember -> Stone -> Spark -> Verdant. The arrow means 'is strong against'. beats[t] is the single type t is strong against; everything else falls out of that, so the matrix cannot drift out of sync with itself.
